_source.title: 获取当前原理图图页的详细属性
_source.remarks.text.0: 将会获取当前打开且拥有最后输入焦点的原理图图页的详细属性
_source.returns: 原理图图页的详细属性，如若为 `undefined` 则获取失败

title: Get detailed properties of Current schematic sheet
remarks.text.0: It will get the detailed properties of the currently open schematic sheet that has the last input focus
returns: Schematic sheet detailed properties of; if it is `undefined`, the retrieval failed
